business_summary.text: Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited operates Cordelia Cruises, India's premium cruise line, offering domestic and international itineraries with an integrated onboard proposition.

call_points.text: Sister ship SUN is confirmed for delivery in 11 months, the same date next year.
₹429 Cr has been advanced towards new vessels, routed through a subsidiary to a mediator as an interest-bearing advance.
Sky carries a $16 million annual lease, treated as an operating cost in projections and below EBITDA under Ind AS.
Average revenue per passenger rose to ₹13,645 in Q2FY27 from ₹10,349 in Q2FY26.

operating_notes.text: Average revenue per passenger increased to ₹13,645 in Q2FY27 from ₹10,349 in Q2FY26.
Average ticket price reached ₹10,300 in Q2FY27 compared to ₹9,529 in Q2FY26.
Cordelia Sky carries an annual lease of $16 million, treated as an operating cost in projections and below EBITDA under Ind AS.
Cordelia Sky accommodates 2,280 guests across 1,002 staterooms.
Cordelia Cruises has welcomed more than 8 lakh guests since 2021.
Cordelia Sun is scheduled to join the fleet in 2027.
